verdict.rationale: Cross-merchant network signals are a fair question for a fraud-scoring product, but no evidence item says Riskified's decisions draw on cards or identities seen across other merchants. The docs cover per-order decide/submit/advise decisions, Beacon device data, model calibration during onboarding and a Plaid data partnership, none of which describes a shared merchant network.

support.subject: As a founder, scoring benefits from a cross-merchant network — a card or identity seen across thousands of other businesses informs the risk decision on mine
